criterion: Effect C1: spectral caustics through measured glass on hardware ray queries, equivalent to its CPU reference within a tolerance contract that catches planted bugs, timed with energy per frame on the RTX 4090
written: 2026-11-02, before the first run of the caustic tracer on any backend

inputs.glasses: SCHOTT N-SF11 (prism) and N-BK7 (lens), dispersion formula 2 coefficients as compiled by refractiveindex.info release v2026-05-24 (CC0), the same rows as web/shaders/lens/glass-data.mjs; status measured (maker's catalogue fit)
inputs.observer: CIE 1931 2 degree colour matching functions, 380 to 780 nm at 5 nm (src/renderer/data/cie1931.hpp)
inputs.lamp: CIE illuminant A by its defining equation (Planck, 2848 K, c2 = 1.435e-2 m K); status defined, not measured
inputs.albedos: floor 0.8, walls 0.6, stands 0.05, spectrally flat; status chosen

definitions.batches: B = 16 independent renders per side, each with its own seed; a pixel's estimate is the batch mean, its variance the batch sample variance over B
definitions.z: per pixel and per channel X, Y, Z: (m_a - m_b) / sqrt(s_a^2 / B + s_b^2 / B); 0 where both sides are 0 in every batch
definitions.image_z: per channel, the difference of image sums over the standard error of that difference from the batch variance of the image sums

K1_hardware_against_cpu.what: prism_room (showcase view) at 192 x 108, 12 bounces, each batch 4 camera samples and 4 photons a pixel (64 and 64 in all), hardware seeds 1000 + i, CPU seeds 5000 + i
K1_hardware_against_cpu.bound: mean |z| <= 0.9 over every pixel and channel; fraction |z| > 4 <= 0.5%; image_z <= 3 on each channel; no non-finite value

K2_estimators_agree.what: on the hardware, the split estimator (camera paths with next-event estimation plus light paths) against the BSDF-only estimator (camera paths only, every emitter hit counted), on prism_room with its lamps enlarged 8 times and cones of 30 degrees, from the view that sees no glass, 96 x 54, each batch 16 camera samples and 16 photons (split) or 1024 camera samples (BSDF-only)
K2_estimators_agree.bound: the K1 bound; and the test must have power: the standard error of the image sum of Y on the BSDF-only side at most 2% of that sum; and no pixel centre of that view sees glass (checked on the CPU)

D1_no_dispersion.what: the hardware with every wavelength at the d-line index, against the K1 CPU reference

D2_drop_splat_cosine.what: the hardware with the light paths' surface cosine dropped at the camera join

D3_offset.what: the hardware instance moved by 1% of the scene box diagonal along (1, 1, 1) / sqrt 3

checks.sweeps: reported, not bounded: a constant added to every glass index (1e-4, 3e-4, 1e-3, 3e-3) and the instance offset at 0.1%, 0.3% and 3%; the smallest that fails K1 is the contract's resolving power at this resolution and sample count

K3_measured_data.what: tests/test_caustic.cpp, on the CPU in every build
K3_measured_data.bound: the Sellmeier index at 587.5618 nm within 5e-5 of the catalogue nd and the Abbe number from 486.1327 and 656.2725 nm within 0.05 of the catalogue vd, for both glasses; glass triangles' winding normals agree in sign with their shading normals

timing: reported, not bounded: on the RTX 4090 at 3840 x 2160, a frame of 1 camera sample and 1 photon a pixel: GPU time of each pass from timestamps over 30 frames after 3 warm-up frames (median, p5, p95), and energy per frame from NVML's total energy counter around those frames, with the idle board power over the same duration recorded beside it; the final still's sample counts and total time
adapters: the RTX 4090 under the D:/lw-gpu lock; WARP where it offers tier 1.1 and shader model 6.6
does_not_prove: That the image is a photograph of this room: polarisation, absorption in the glass, coatings, the lamp's real spectrum and geometry, and the paths through glass after a diffuse bounce back to the camera through glass are not modelled; equivalence on other scenes or sample counts.

addendum_1.written: 2026-11-02, after run 1 (evidence/hw-c1-caustic-rtx4090-run1.json) and before run 2; the bounds above are unchanged
addendum_1.finding: Run 1 failed the contract twice. D1 (no dispersion) stayed within the K1 bound: the spectrum covers well under 1% of the 192 x 108 pixels, so whole-image statistics cannot see a change confined to it. K2 failed (mean |z| 0.97, 1.4% of values past 4); diagnosis traced it to the random numbers, not the estimators (runs file).
addendum_1.change_1_region: Every K1 comparison (K1, D1 to D3, sweeps) is also made over the caustic region: the pixels where the CPU reference's light paths carry at least 5% of Y (batch means). A case is within the K1 bound only when the whole image and the region both meet it.
addendum_1.change_2_random_numbers: The caustic tracer's random numbers move from the path tracer's PCG2D over (pixel, sample * 64 + dimension) to a nested lowbias32 hash of (seed, pixel, sample, dimension), on CPU and GPU alike, and the wavelength takes dimension 63. With the old numbers the split and BSDF-only estimators of the glass-free room differed by 1.5 to 3% and the gap changed sign when only the wavelength's dimension moved; with the new numbers they agree within 0.2%, the seed-to-seed spread.
addendum_1.not_changed: K2's bound, the controls, the sample counts and the scenes of K1

addendum_2.written: 2026-11-02, after run 2 (evidence/hw-c1-caustic-rtx4090-run2.json) and before run 3; no bound changed
addendum_2.finding: Run 2: K1 and D1 to D3 met their bounds; K2 failed again (mean |z| 0.986, 1.6% past 4) while its image sums met theirs. At 4096 split samples against 262144 BSDF-only samples the two estimators' image sums agree within 0.04% on every channel (diagnostic renders, runs file).
addendum_2.change: A reported row, K2_null: the K2 test between two BSDF-only seed sets. It has no bound. If it fails as K2 does, the per-pixel z test is miscalibrated for this estimator (rare lamp hits make the batch variance underestimate the true variance), and K2's failure says that, not that the estimators disagree.
